zh.sourceText: 人工智能正在走进课堂。不少学校开始用 AI 助教为学生答疑，校长表示：AI 能根据每个学生的水平定制练习，所以我们决定下个学期在全校引入 AI 助教。学生们也觉得，问 AI 比举手提问更自在，不用担心被同学笑话。但一线老师们则提醒：AI 也可能给出错误答案，而且长期依赖 AI 可能会削弱学生独立思考的能力。某教育科技公司趁势宣传：『AI 助教，让孩子爱上学习，一用就上瘾！』

textRefs.conclusion_1: 我们决定下个学期在全校引入 AI 助教
textRefs.reason_1: AI 能根据每个学生的水平定制练习
textRefs.reason_2: 问 AI 比举手提问更自在，不用担心被同学笑话
textRefs.distractor_1: AI 助教，让孩子爱上学习，一用就上瘾
textRefs.distractor_2: AI 也可能给出错误答案

hints: 结论是校长做的决定，找『我们要做什么』
两个理由：一个关于学习效果，一个关于学生心理
老师的提醒和公司的广告语，哪一个是支持理由？
zh.explanation: 结论是校长的决定「全校引入 AI 助教」。理由一：AI 能个性化定制练习（效果）；理由二：学生问 AI 不害羞（心理门槛降低）。「AI 可能给错误答案」「削弱独立思考」是老师的反对意见；「让孩子爱上学习」是营销口号，都不是支撑结论的理由。注意：论证中出现的每一句话不一定都在为结论服务。

en.sourceText: AI is entering the classroom. Many schools are using AI teaching assistants to answer students' questions. The principal says: AI can create practice tailored to each student's level, so we have decided to introduce AI assistants school-wide next semester. Students also feel more comfortable asking an AI than raising their hand, without worrying about being laughed at. But frontline teachers warn that AI can also give wrong answers, and that long-term reliance on AI may weaken students' independent thinking. An edtech company is cashing in: 'AI assistant — make kids love learning, addictive at first use!'

textRefs.conclusion_1: we have decided to introduce AI assistants school-wide next semester
textRefs.reason_1: AI can create practice tailored to each student's level
textRefs.reason_2: Students also feel more comfortable asking an AI than raising their hand
textRefs.distractor_1: make kids love learning, addictive at first use
textRefs.distractor_2: AI can also give wrong answers

hints: The conclusion is the principal's decision — find the 'we will do X'
Two reasons: one about learning effect, one about student psychology
The teachers' warning and the company's slogan — which supports the conclusion?
en.explanation: The conclusion is the principal's decision: 'introduce AI assistants school-wide'. Reason one: AI personalizes practice (effect). Reason two: students feel less embarrassed asking an AI (lower psychological barrier). 'AI can give wrong answers' and 'weaken independent thinking' are teachers' objections; 'make kids love learning' is a marketing slogan. Not every sentence in an argument serves the conclusion — that's the point.
